verdict.rationale: Zero is an email client, so shared team inboxes are a fair question for it. The evidence never documents shared accounts, team channels, or shared conversation state. The 'Unified Inbox' feature connects one user's multiple email providers, which is an adjacent feature rather than team collaboration, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
